name: Photomap NZ
story: Photomap NZ Ltd was a Nelson mapping business. Its December 2011 company signature names Cathy McBride and Mark Holmes. Holmes’s practitioner correspondence documents continued use of ArcView 3.2 and questions about coordinate conversion and compatibility with newer computers.

Photomap’s owners, Cathy McBride and Mark Holmes, designed trail map boards for Codgers Mountain Bike Park. A January 2013 council newsletter describes the work, connecting the commercial mapping practice with the local mountain-bike club and public GIS data.
